name: Asia Online
summary: Pan-Asia-Pacific ISP (Softbank-led from 1999); acquired Access Australia, InterACT, Internet Company NZ (Oct 1999), then Spirit Internet, Brisbane Internet Technology, Dove, Message Exchange; Australian ops in Sydney/Adelaide/Melbourne; went bust late 2001, subscriber base to OzEmail.

events.details: Asia Online Ltd formed from Softbank-led consortium adopting the Asia Online name.
Went bust late 2001; dial-up subscriber base sold to OzEmail.
